title: WordPress and frontend repos get the boilerplate-2026 skill set from one source
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-15: the frontend approach lives in /mnt/storage/coding/krn/active/boilerplate-2026 (.agents/skills: acf-component, cube-css, cube-review, design-to-build, plesk-deploy, wp-runtime) and "na pewno nie będzie jeden skill"; per-language skills nobody uses are dropped (t-1anb38k, t-vrc1nvx, t-664sxme, t-z1htfen won't do).
Why: a WordPress or frontend repo adopted by KRN gets none of the operator's real frontend skills; copies would drift from their source.
Outcome: the installer (src/adopt/skill-set.ts from t-6vn9c9j) installs the boilerplate-2026 skill set into WordPress/frontend repos from one pinned source (a recorded commit of boilerplate-2026, no hand copies), each skill whole (all files); deployment-specific ones (plesk-deploy) only where the repo deploys to Plesk; drift reports a source update; skill-creator's checks pass on every installed skill.
Files: src/adopt/skill-set.ts, src/adopt/skills/ or a source pin file, src/adopt/drift.ts, test/adopt/
Proof: adopt on the wp-plugin and frontend outside scratch copies installs the set; the wp-plugin row drains 0 with it.
Predicted: outside drain == 0 in >= 2 rows
